home.sc.sub.message: Grab a script from the store — ads, video, shopping, productivity, all handled for you.

home.sc.featured.d.message: Speed control, auto-skip ads, one-click download, picture-in-picture — a better Bilibili / YouTube / Netflix.

home.sc.adblock.d.message: Block ads and popups for a clean, tidy page.

home.sc.shop.d.message: Compare prices everywhere, price-history charts, one-click coupons.

home.sc.auto.d.message: Auto check-in, batch actions, a handy little toolbox.

home.sc.read.d.message: Dark mode, page translation, immersive reading.

home.step.sub.message: No complex setup — just follow three steps: install and go.

home.step1.d.message: Add it from the Chrome / Edge / Firefox store in one click, or install manually.

home.step2.d.message: Explore thousands of scripts in the ScriptCat community and pick a favorite.

home.step3.d.message: Click install and the script takes effect on the page right away.

home.feat.sub.message: From compatibility to security, from everyday users to developers — ScriptCat has it covered.

home.feat.compat.d.message: Fully compatible with the userscript format and GM APIs — migrate existing scripts with zero changes and no switching cost.

home.feat.compat.b.message: Supports GM_* APIs · identical metadata block

home.feat.store.d.message: Install thousands of community scripts in one click, or publish your own and build the ecosystem together.

home.feat.secure.d.message: Transparent, controllable permissions and visible behavior — malicious scripts stopped at the source.

home.feat.sync.d.message: Scripts and settings sync across devices — nothing lost when you switch or reinstall.

home.dev.sub.message: Background scripts, rich APIs, a built-in editor and debugging tools — from your first line to production, all in one place.

home.dev.bg.d.message: No pinned tab required — scripts keep running in the background.

home.dev.api.d.message: File storage, cron scheduling and cross-origin requests — all included.

home.dev.editor.d.message: Syntax highlighting, smart completion and error hints make scripting smooth.

home.dev.debug.d.message: Logs, run history and error tracking — problems at a glance.

home.dev.mock.name.description: @name value in the editor mock code block

home.dev.mock.toast.description: Notification text in the editor mock code block

home.comm.sub.message: Fully open source, transparent and free. Every line of code is auditable, every contributor is seen.

home.cta.sub.message: Install from the store in one click, or download the package manually. 30 seconds to unlock web superpowers.

home.cta.stores.message: Supports Edge · Chrome · Firefox · manual package

home.hero.lead.message: Block ads, power up video, automate the busywork — install community scripts from the store in one click. Tampermonkey-compatible, with background scripts, a rich API and AI integration for developers.

home.hero.demo.popupSub.message: Click to claim a mystery gift

home.sc.auto.h.message: Let scripts do the repetitive stuff

home.sc.stage.readSrc.message: 用户脚本让你按自己的习惯，重塑任何网站的阅读、观看与购物体验。装上一个，页面立刻改变 —— 无需开发扩展，也不用写一行代码。

home.sc.stage.readDst.message: Userscripts let you reshape any website to fit the way you read, watch and shop. Install one, and the page changes instantly — no extension to build, no code to write.

home.ai.sub.message: With the sctl CLI, AI coding agents like Claude Code and Codex can write ScriptCat scripts, install them into your browser to check the result, and fix what they find before trying again.

home.ai.agents.d.message: Give Claude Code or Codex the scriptcat-userscript and sctl skills and it knows how ScriptCat scripts are written — and can check them in your browser and fix them itself.

home.ai.sctl.d.message: List, install and run scripts and read their logs from the terminal — or drive tabs and pages, or hand CDP to Playwright.

home.ai.term.prompt.message: Write me a script that defaults Bilibili videos to 1080p, then install it in my browser and try it
